jeletask is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0, see LICENSE.md.
Its source code is available at https://github.com/ridiekel/jeletask.

It includes the third-party libraries below, each under its own licence:

  THIRD-PARTY.txt   every library with its version and licence
  libraries/        the NOTICE and LICENSE files the libraries ship in their jars
  licenses/         licence texts for the libraries whose jar has none, see licenses/libraries.properties

The native image contains these libraries compiled into the application binary.
